description:
Hand crafted in the heart of the UK using Reynolds 853 Pro Team double butted steel tubing, this lightweight racing bike is detailed with a cloverleaf design hand cut into the lugs, with ‘shot-in’ seat stays to give the frame a sleek sporty look.

The Strada Speciale is an agile, lightweight sports bike. Crafted with precision-cut lugs, it is engineered for rapid road riding and spirited day excursions. Delivering vintage looks with speed and responsive handling, the Strada Speciale is a perfect blend of classic style and modern performance.

With carbon forks and disc brakes as standard (rim brakes also an option), it is available as frame-only or fully assembled: choose one of our three assembly packages - or we can help you build up the assembly to your own specification.
